commands.command:
set -eu
KEYDIR=/run/branch-stock-key
CREDDIR=/root/branch_stock-credentials

STOCK_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] -F: '$1=="stock_app" {print $2}' "$KEYDIR/credentials")
AUDITOR_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] -F: '$1=="auditor" {print $2}' "$KEYDIR/credentials")

rm -f "$KEYDIR/private.pem" "$KEYDIR/public.pem" "$KEYDIR/credentials.enc" "$KEYDIR/credentials"
rmdir "$KEYDIR"
printf 'separate_passwords=[REDACTED]]]

commands.command:
set -eu
NODE1_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node1" {print $1}')
TMPDIR=/run/branch-stock-tests
install -d -m 700 "$TMPDIR"
trap 'rm -f "$TMPDIR"/*; rmdir "$TMPDIR" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
printf '%s\n' 'stock_app-allowed-read-and-quantity-update-with-rollback:'
PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/stock_app.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U stock_app -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -t -c "BEGIN; SELECT 'read_rows='||count(*) FROM stock; UPDATE stock SET quantity=quantity+1 WHERE sku='PAPER'; SELECT 'updated_quantity='||quantity FROM stock WHERE sku='PAPER'; ROLLBACK; SELECT 'restored_quantity='||quantity FROM stock WHERE sku='PAPER';"
if PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/stock_app.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U stock_app -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM supplier_costs' >"$TMPDIR/stock_supplier" 2>&1; then
  echo 'stock_app_supplier_costs_denied=no'; exit 1
else
  printf 'stock_app_supplier_costs_denied=yes '; grep -Eo 'ERROR:.*' "$TMPDIR/stock_supplier" | head -1
fi
if PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/stock_app.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U stock_app -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'CREATE TABLE unauthorized_schema_change(id integer)' >"$TMPDIR/stock_ddl" 2>&1; then
  echo 'stock_app_schema_change_denied=no'; exit 1
else
  printf 'stock_app_schema_change_denied=yes '; grep -Eo 'ERROR:.*' "$TMPDIR/stock_ddl" | head -1
fi
if PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/stock_app.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U stock_app -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "UPDATE stock SET sku='CHANGED' WHERE sku='PAPER'" >"$TMPDIR/stock_sku" 2>&1; then
  echo 'stock_app_nonquantity_update_denied=no'; exit 1
else
  printf 'stock_app_nonquantity_update_denied=yes '; grep -Eo 'ERROR:.*' "$TMPDIR/stock_sku" | head -1
fi
printf '%s\n' 'auditor-allowed-reads-and-exact-record-check:'
PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/auditor.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U auditor -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -t <<'SQL'
SELECT 'stock_rows='||count(*) FROM stock;
SELECT 'supplier_cost_rows='||count(*) FROM supplier_costs;
WITH expected(sku,quantity) AS (VALUES ('PAPER'::varchar,40),('LABELS'::varchar,18)) SELECT 'stock_exact='||((NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT sku,quantity FROM stock)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT sku,quantity FROM stock EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)))::text;
WITH expected(sku,cost) AS (VALUES ('PAPER'::varchar,3.25::numeric),('LABELS'::varchar,1.75::numeric)) SELECT 'supplier_costs_exact='||((NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT sku,cost FROM supplier_costs)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT sku,cost FROM supplier_costs EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)))::text;
SQL
if PGPASSFILE=/root/branch_stock-credentials/auditor.pgpass psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U auditor -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "UPDATE stock SET quantity=quantity+1 WHERE sku='PAPER'" >"$TMPDIR/auditor_update" 2>&1; then
  echo 'auditor_update_denied=no'; exit 1
else
  printf 'auditor_update_denied=yes '; grep -Eo 'ERROR:.*' "$TMPDIR/auditor_update" | head -1
fi
STOCK_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] -F: '{print $5}' /root/branch_stock-credentials/stock_app.pgpass)
if PGPASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] psql -X -h "$NODE1_IP" -U auditor -d branch_stock -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'SELECT 1' >"$TMPDIR/cross_auth" 2>&1; then
  echo 'credentials_independent=no'; exit 1
else
  echo 'credentials_independent=yes (stock_app credential rejected for auditor)'
fi
printf '%s\n' 'cleanup-check:'
[ ! -e "$TMPDIR/unauthorized_schema_change" ]
echo 'test_artifacts_removed_by_exit_trap=yes'

SQL
